project: Strengthening U.S. Oyster Broodstock Systems (USDA NIFA award 2026-68012-47021)
note: Coordinates are water-body level, not lease locations. Sites are labeled by water body; farm names are not shown.

sites.name: York River, VA
sites.context: Research farm. Routine Dermo pressure, periodic MSX.
sites.gaps: CBNERR-VA (Gloucester Point, Goodwin Islands, Claybank) and VIMS VECOS are closer for DO, pH and chlorophyll but are not yet wired in (NERRS web services need a registered IP).

sites.name: Hungars Creek, VA
sites.context: Commercial farm, bay side of the Eastern Shore. Region with sudden unusual mortality events.
sites.gaps: No public gauge in the creek. Nearest observations are 26 km (Kiptopeke) and 31 km (mid-bay buoy); neither represents a shallow tidal creek. Salinity from the Stingray Point buoy arrives 1000 times too large upstream and is dropped until that is fixed.

sites.name: Topsail Sound, NC
sites.context: Commercial farm. Region with sudden unusual mortality events.

usgs.name: Northeast Cape Fear River near Chinquapin (regional runoff proxy)

sites.gaps: No public T/S gauge in the sound. The tide station is on the ocean side, so sound tides lag it. Nearest water observations are about 30 km south.

sites.name: Corpus Christi Bay, TX
sites.context: Research farm. Salinity swings, high temperature.
sites.gaps: TWDB coastal datasondes are not yet wired in. Dissolved oxygen from the Nueces Bay station is left out because the feed is mis-scaled upstream (values near 0.007 labeled mg/L).

sites.name: Matagorda Bay, TX (second Texas site, to be confirmed)
sites.context: Commercial farm. Frequent low-salinity events. Bay not yet confirmed (Matagorda vs Copano).
sites.gaps: No public real-time salinity found in the bay yet; TWDB and LCRA sondes are candidates. If the site is Copano Bay, switch to CO-OPS 8774513 (Copano Bay) and 8774770 (Rockport).

sites.name: Netarts Bay, OR
sites.context: Commercial farm. Hypoxia and low-pH, corrosive water.

usgs.name: Wilson River near Tillamook (regional runoff proxy)

sites.gaps: No public T/S gauge in the bay; Garibaldi is 15 km north in a different estuary. Whiskey Creek Hatchery carbonate chemistry (NANOOS/IPACOA) is the key in-bay record and is not yet wired in.

sites.name: Willapa Bay, WA
sites.context: Commercial lease. Elevated summer mortality, high summer temperature.
sites.gaps: No public salinity. NANOOS/IPACOA Bay Center and Nahcotta and WA Ecology stations are not yet wired in.

sites.name: VIMS ABC hatchery, Gloucester Point, VA
sites.context: Aquaculture Genetics and Breeding Technology Center hatchery; source water is the York River.

sites.name: Texas A&M mariculture facility, Flour Bluff, TX
sites.context: AgriLife Mariculture Research Facility; location approximate.
sites.gaps: Source water is the upper Laguna Madre; no public salinity nearby.

sites.name: ARS broodstock repository, Yaquina Bay, OR
sites.context: POGS broodstock raft and Hatfield Marine Science Center, Newport.

sites.name: NOAA Manchester Research Station, WA
sites.context: NOAA research hatchery; commercial breeding partner co-located.
sites.gaps: Seattle is 16 km east across the main basin. UW LiveOcean and ORCA buoys are not yet wired in.
